---
title: "Publication Build"
---

The public site is a GitHub Pages artifact rendered from multiple Quarto projects.

## Build Command

```bash
make site
```

This renders:

```text
publication/
publication/engineering/
publication/projects/sacrificial-debt/
```

into:

```text
publication/_site/
```

## GitHub Pages

The expected Pages URL is:

<https://ashitaka-emishi.github.io/fspp-research-workbench/>

The source repository is:

<https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-workbench>

## Generated Output

`publication/_site/` and Quarto cache directories are generated artifacts. They are ignored by Git and should be rebuilt from source files.

Canonical evidence remains in project data, research, codebook, corpus, and schema files. The website is a rendered review and publication surface.
